subject: [hw] V34 -> V03: n2elf_describe picks the previous symbol for the exact address of every Thumb function
body:
Finding (loader, LOW but user-visible in traces and in dladdr): n2elf_describe(s, addr, ...) masks the address (a = addr & ~1u) and then compares sym.st_value <= off, but on this set every FUNC st_value has the Thumb bit set (e.g. eVideoMemAlloc st_value = 0x17e61). For the exact start of a function, off = 0x17e60 < 0x17e61, so the symbol is skipped and the *previous* one is reported.

Repro: load libvcodec_utility.so (V03 test fixture path works), then
  n2elf_describe(s, n2elf_sym(s, "eVideoMemAlloc") & ~1u, buf, sizeof buf)
returns "libvcodec_utility.so:eVideoFlushCache+0x177" instead of "...:eVideoMemAlloc+0x0".
Also for an address inside the function, describe returns eVideoMemAlloc but with an offset 1 too large (it compares the odd st_value with the even offset).

Suggested fix: compare (sym.st_value & ~1u) with off, and report off - (sym.st_value & ~1u). With that, describe(addr) is right for the exact start and for interior addresses.

Impact here: V34 s dladdr shim needs "which symbol contains this address". I work around it today by asking describe one byte later and taking dli_saddr from n2elf_sym() by name, which is correct either way, so this is not a blocker for V34. It does affect any trace/debug consumer of describe for a function start.

Evidence: emu ... no, loader/n2elf.c:1040-1100; call sites and output on the current tree (gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/t_core.c has the check; my t_core passes 103/103 with the workaround).
